commit_message: Fix Curve Editor lint and constrained layout
pr_body:
## Summary

- add a Sequencer Curve Editor for all Transform-backed Property Track numeric channels
- edit key time, value, interpolation, add/delete keys, and preserve clip-local ticks
- integrate Redo with the existing validated Timeline edit/compile/save path
- cover undo/redo and save/reopen preservation of stable IDs and exact key ticks
- keep key editing visible before a responsive curve graph in constrained Sequencer height
